questions.prompt: Which of these earn you XP? Select all that apply.
questions.explanation: XP comes from work that actually moved: completing tasks, logging time, hitting milestones, receiving kudos, and publishing a blog post. Opening the app and reading the board earn nothing — attendance is not contribution.

questions.prompt: What is the rank ladder, in order from the bottom?
questions.explanation: Nestling → Fledgling → Cadet → Specialist → Pioneer → Cosmonaut → Celestial, from 0 up to 21,000 XP. Rank is display and recognition; it does not change what you are allowed to do in the product.

questions.prompt: What is the difference between XP and doubloons?
questions.explanation: XP is a permanent record that only goes up and drives your rank. Doubloons are a currency you spend in the shop on cosmetics. Spending doubloons never costs you rank.

questions.prompt: Reaching a higher rank unlocks features in Constellation that lower ranks cannot use.
questions.explanation: False. Rank is recognition, not permission. What you can do is governed by your role and by per-project access — a Nestling and a Celestial with the same role can do exactly the same things.
